objectives.title: International Data Transfer Conditions
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions addressing conditions for personal data transfers outside the European Union.
criteria: Provisions requiring that transfers of personal data to a third country comply with the conditions laid down in Chapter V.
Provisions requiring that transfers of personal data to an international organisation comply with the conditions laid down in Chapter V.
Confirmation that the Chapter V conditions bind the processor as well as the controller.

objectives.title: Onward Transfer Governance
objectives.description: The contract contains provisions regulating downstream transfers across jurisdictions.
criteria: Provisions requiring that onward transfers of the data from a third-country recipient comply with the Chapter V conditions.
Provisions requiring that onward transfers of the data from an international-organisation recipient comply with the Chapter V conditions.
Clauses restricting onward transfers to further third countries or international organisations not authorised under the Chapter V conditions.
